extracted.name: Chantilly cream
extracted.description: Make your own to enjoy with a dessert, to fill a tiered cake or sticky buns, or to pile on top of fresh summer berries and soft fruit
instruction_lines: Whip the cream, sugar and vanilla together in a bowl using a hand blender or electric whisk until the mixture forms soft peaks. Will keep chilled for a few hours. Serve spooned or piped alongside desserts or as a filling for cakes or buns. It's also delicious served with soft summer fruits and berries.
